title: Ren — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 16100, 16110, 16111, 16112, 16114; WZ API for 5th job skills and HEXA cores)

skills.name: Grounded Body
skills.description:
Controls both body and mind through intense training, resisting the damage dealt by enemy attacks.

Level 3: Permanently increases Damage for Ren.

skills.name: Return
skills.description: Returns to the Serpent's Heartwaters

skills.name: Free Spirit
skills.description: Grants you the ability to move like a petal dancing on the wind through intense footwork training.

skills.name: Serene Verse
skills.description: Hones your inner power with disciplined mental training.

skills.name: Plum Blossom Sword: Slice
skills.description: Slices your enemies with an elegant slash, a founding technique of the Plum Blossom Sword.

skills.name: Serene Breeze
skills.description: Allows you to double jump. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Lilting Petal
skills.description:
Sends you dancing through the air like a scattered plum blossom.
Holding the key down after using the skill suspends you in the air for a short time and allows you to use aerial skills. Use the arrow keys while suspended to move in that direction.
Also permanently increases Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike
skills.description: Manifests Saya's bequeathed love to imbue your sword with the strength of an Imugi. Striking an enemy with Dancing Annihilation or a founding Plum Blossom Sword technique will unleash an additional attack. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sword Mastery
skills.description: Hones your sword hand through intense training with your blade.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Builds your Strength through a bodybuilding regimen.

skills.name: Serene Verse II
skills.description: Further hones your inner power with disciplined mental training.

skills.name: Plum Blossom Sword: Strike
skills.description: Pierces your enemies with a well-aimed forward strike, a founding technique of the Plum Blossom Sword.

skills.name: First Plum Blossom Sword: Petal Flash
skills.description:
Channels your inner power to your legs, unsheathing your sword and teleporting forward. Once drawn, using the skill again will sheathe your sword.
You can register Petal Flash, Unsheathe, and Sheathe to separate hotkeys.
Also permanently increases Max HP.

skills.name: First Plum Blossom Sword: Petal Flash - Sheathe
skills.description:
Sheathes your sword and teleports you backwards.
SP is not required for this skill, which shares the skill level of First Plum Blossom Sword: Petal Flash.

skills.name: Blossoming Blade
skills.description: Temporarily increases the Attack Speed of your sword.

skills.name: First Plum Blossom Sword: Petal Flash - Unsheathe
skills.description:
Unsheathes your sword and teleports you forward.
SP is not required for this skill, which shares the skill level of First Plum Blossom Sword: Petal Flash.

skills.name: Second Plum Blossom Sword: Raining Blossoms
skills.description: Transforms the spiritual energy lingering over enemies you attack, showering them in slicing petals. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike II
skills.description: Deepens your connection to Saya's power further, enhancing the additional strike unleashed when you hit an enemy with Dancing Annihilation or a founding Plum Blossom Sword technique. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: First Imugi Spirit Sword: Serpent's Blessing
skills.description:
Envelopes your body in Saya's power when a direct skill attack lands, her warm embrace recovering your HP and increasing your Status Resistance. Does not activate with some skills.
Not affected by effects which reset or reduce cooldowns.

skills.name: Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Burrowing Earth
skills.description: Splits the earth with a sword strike infused with the strength of a burrowing Imugi.

skills.name: Serene Verse III
skills.description: Raises your inner power to the threshold of enlightenment through disciplined mental training.

skills.name: Ironbark Body
skills.description: Grants your body the resilience of an unbowed plum blossom tree through ceaseless training.

skills.name: Plum Blossom Sword: Slash
skills.description: Rends your enemies with spinning sword strikes, a founding technique of the Plum Blossom Sword.

skills.name: Second Plum Blossom Sword: Raining Blossoms
Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike II
Wish Unending
skills.description: Charges your sword with power drawn from Saya's deepest wish--that you would use her strength to show the world how a dragon soars. Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns.

skills.name: Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Burrowing Earth
skills.description: Splits the earth with a sword strike infused with the strength of a burrowing Imugi.

skills.name: Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Burrowing Earth
Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike III
skills.description: Deepens your connection to Saya's power further, enhancing the additional strike unleashed when you hit an enemy with Dancing Annihilation or a founding Plum Blossom Sword technique. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Ravenous Spirit
skills.description: Strikes with a sword infused with Saya's power, which surges forward to devour your foes with the fury of a ravenous imugi. Can be used after Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Burrowing Earth.

skills.name: Second Imugi Spirit Sword: Serpent's Fang
skills.description: Ignites the power Saya invested in your heart, giving it a chance to deal an additional attack when a direct skill attack lands. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Exquisite Sword Mastery
skills.description: Hones your sword hand to the heights of mastery through intense training with your blade.

skills.name: Serene Verse IV
skills.description: Raises your inner power to the summit of enlightenment through your disciplined mental training.

skills.name: Eyes Unclouded
skills.description: Refines your capacity to see to the heart of the matter through the wisdom found only by wandering.

skills.name: Spirit Strike - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike.

skills.name: Spirit Strike - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike.

skills.name: Spirit Strike - Spread
skills.description: Increases the number of enemies hit by Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike.

skills.name: Storm - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Plum Blossom Sword: Storm.

skills.name: Storm - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Plum Blossom Sword: Storm.

skills.name: Storm - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases the Boss Damage of Plum Blossom Sword: Storm.

skills.name: Wish Unending - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of the Final Imugi Spirit Sword techniques: Burrowing Earth, Ravenous Spirit, Years Uncounted, and Blade of the Unbound Heart.

skills.name: Wish Unending - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of the Final Imugi Spirit Sword technique: Burrowing Earth, Ravenous Spirit, Years Uncounted, and Blade of the Unbound Heart.

skills.name: Wish Unending - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases the Critical Rate of the Final Imugi Spirit Sword techniques: Burrowing Earth, Ravenous Spirit, Years Uncounted, and Blade of the Unbound Heart.

skills.name: Plum Blossom Sword: Storm
skills.description: Cuts down the enemies before you in a storm of blinding speed, a founding technique of the Plum Blossom Sword. Hold the skill key to continually attack. This skill can be combined with Serene Breeze.

skills.name: Imugi Spirit Sword: Spirit Strike III
Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Ravenous Spirit
skills.description: Strikes with a sword infused with Saya's power, which surges forward to devour your foes with the fury of a ravenous imugi. Can be used after Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Burrowing Earth.

skills.name: Third Plum Blossom Sword: Riotous Heart
skills.description:
Projects the sword-sharp edges of your heart, creating a sphere of power that moves forward to cut down anything in its path. Once the sphere reaches a certain distance, it will regenerate and travel in the opposite direction. The sphere vanishes after regenerating a certain number of times.
Using Unity will switch the skill to Hearts United. When Hearts United is activated, the sphere of power will move forward slowly without regenerating.
Does not activate First Imugi Spirit Sword: Serpent's Blessing. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Fourth Plum Blossom Sword: Unbowed Blade
skills.description: Intercepts all attacks made against you, rendering them little more than petals whirling around a plum tree. Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns.

skills.name: Fourth Plum Blossom Sword: Unbowed Blade
skills.description: Intercepts all attacks made against you, rendering them little more than petals whirling around a plum tree. Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns.

skills.name: Anima Warrior
skills.description: The Grandis Goddess's protection increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Grandis Goddess appear.

skills.name: Anima Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Third Plum Blossom Sword: Hearts United
skills.description:
Projects the indomitable bond of your and Saya's united hearts, creating a sphere of power that moves forward to cut down anything in its path.
Using Unity will switch the skill to Riotous Heart.
Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns. Does not activate First Imugi Spirit Sword: Serpent's Blessing. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Unity
skills.description: Unites the martial discipline of the Plum Blossom Sword with the unbridled power of the Imugi Spirit Sword, creating sword techniques wieldable only by the Red-Eyed Wanderer.

skills.name: Sublimation
skills.description: Burns your inner power to surpass your current limits and strengthen your mastery of the Final Imugi Spirit Sword techniques.

skills.name: Fifth Plum Blossom Sword: Plum Branch Snare
skills.description: Slices the enemy faster than the eye can follow, your inner power bursting from each strike to ensnare your foes like grasping plum branches.

skills.name: Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Years Uncounted
skills.description:
Unleashes countless sword strikes, each marking a milestone on an imugi's path to become a dragon. Can be used after Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Ravenous Spirit.
The flames ignited by Saya's power are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Years Uncounted
HEXA Wish Unending
skills.description:
Obliterates your enemies with blasts of Saya's power after the Final Imugi Spirit Sword techniques have been used a certain number of times.
The blasts are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Divided Heavens
skills.description:
Lets loose the power of the heavens, as the perfect fusion of your inner strength with Saya's bequeathed power grants your sword the might of the Azure Dragon.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Falling Flower
skills.description:
A single flower falls, only to raise a wind that shakes the world, sending your sword dancing along the weathered path of your heart.
Use the skill again while the sword wind blows to unleash the Climbing Serpent technique.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%

skills.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Climbing Serpent
skills.description:
Saya and Ren's combined hearts rise as a serpent triumphant, breaking through the very heavens.
Use the skill again within a certain period of time to unleash the Soaring Dragon technique.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%

skills.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Soaring Dragon
skills.description:
Your sword flies like soaring dragon, crushing the wicked beneath the reign of the Azure Dragon.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%

skills.name: Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse - Falling Flower
Rising Azure Dragon: Heartbound Verse
skills.description:
No flower blooms without someday falling...and once it has, no power can make it blossom again, even though the heavens shake. Take up your sword, Wanderer--for whether you wield it in hope or in grief, the world sorely needs a dragon.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
